review_scope: Technical screen review of 23 production captures against main. Recorded lighting differences and inherited obstructed views. No owner play or artistic acceptance.

images.observation: Floorboards, furniture and ceiling fitting remain readable under warm light. The spectral patch remains visible on the floor.
The curtain and tile courses stay legible at the edge of the beam. The tile highlight has the same broad falloff.
The floorboards, furnishings and resident retain their silhouettes under the ceiling lamp and bright doorway.
Shelf, chair and piano retain their placement and readable shapes under the room and companion lights.
Cabinet, sink and floor edges remain readable. The candidate's beam reads as a smoother circle and the small wall highlights differ.
The boiler face, gauge and pipes remain legible. Its edges and shadow are visible against the darker service room.
The chair, case and corridor show the same placement and materials. The chair partly covers the shelves in both frames.
Tile joints, the vertical service line and toilet hardware retain their readable edges.
The camera is close against dark brick in both views. This is a wall coverage view with the machinery out of sight.
The open door, fuses and conduit retain clear edges against the rough wall.
The rail, tiles and partial scene silhouette remain visible. The stand and overhead surface substantially obscure the subject.
Portrait, shelf and orange prop retain their positions and colors. The top of the composition remains dim.
The reddish underside fills the upper view, with wall portraits visible below. The angle still obscures much of the subject.
Mailbox bank, bench and chutes remain visible in dim light. Individual label text remains difficult to read.
Radiator fins, valve, curtains and sill retain their positions and readable silhouettes.
The roof door and stair guard runs are continuous in the view. Ceiling conduit and lamp remain visible.
The tank, ladders and support frame retain their outlines against the roofline and sky.
The green terminal lighting, console surfaces and panel remain visible. Angle and distance limit panel text readability.
The tile lines, pipe and paper fixture remain legible under the same framing.
The colored residue remains distinct from the wood floor and radiator in the companion beam.
The installed tentacle's ridges and silhouette are distinct from the radiator and floor.
The toaster, crumb tray and kettle remain visible on the intact countertop.
The candidate wall receives less side light than main. The dark station outline and label plate are still visible, with reduced detail on the controls.
